race.comment: FORGOTTEN SPIRIT (8) looked the winner when resuming last start over 1000m at Eagle Farm but was nutted right on the line. Running a strong 1200m is the query but she has the quality to test this field. GRINZINGER CHAMP (6) took a long while to stoke up under the big weight but got the job done again as favourite last time out over this course and distance. Takes on the boys today but she keeps improving and will be tough to hold out. GOSPEL GIRL (3) is back after a 20-week break. Beaten a lip in a similar race to this at the Farm when fresh from a spell last prep. Going great guns at the trials so she looks fully wound up. ACAPPELLA SUN (2) has placed once in nine first-up runs so her fifth when resuming last start was par for the course. Has a far better second-up record and she likes Doomben so this is a nice assignment. The consistent TORNADO EXPRESS (7) has won four from six at this distance so he is difficult to rule out.
